report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; p95 for /v1/checkout is ~98ms and 502 count is 0. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) with pool size/idle=1. No error, latency, or saturation signal supports any taxonomy cause; the alert reflects normal behavior, so no bounded root cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Evidence of elevated error rate or latency (e.g., non-200 responses, p95 above SLO) on /v1/checkout
Baseline latency/SLO thresholds to judge whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Downstream dependency latency or timeout metrics for inventory, payment, redis, postgres
Resource saturation metrics (connection pool, CPU, memory) for order and downstream services
